referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the entire transport life cycle. Airport infrastructure expenditures and environmental interventions are accounted for using the yearly transport performance at Zurich airport (73'526'350'051 pkm/a). Aircraft manufacturing is allocated based on the total life span of an aircraft (50'000LTO), the average distance of a flight (750km) and its average number of passengers (126p/unit); UUID: e0d5240a-97a4-3862-8299-3db5a2ca84ce
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset describes the operation of aircrafts including taxying, take-off and landing covering fuel consumption and operation emissions. Aircraft manufacture and maintenance, airport construction, operation and dismantling are inputs to this dataset
referenceFunction.name: Transport, aircraft, passenger, short-haul, Infrastruktur

technology.text: Aircraft operation modelled based on passenger aircrafts operated by Lufthansa Group in 2019. The emission profiles distinguish between LTO and cruise.

timePeriod.text: Start date refers to emission factor data. End date refers to year of reporting fuel consumption and transport activities

representativeness.extrapolations: Allocation between passengers and freight based on weight (average passenger weight between 158kg and 163kg); allocation between booking classes based on seat area.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: fuel consumption is based on corporate data, emission profiles are based on FOEN statistics
